'''Admiral Thrawn Undercover How can that help me''' is a strategy article published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] under the handle Admiral Thrawn, titled ''Undercover...How can that help me????''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Undercover.htm Undercover...How can that help me????], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142511/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Undercover.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
